title: 第2258章 给你一个选择机会第2257章 还有点用
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: “回主人，我并不清楚青虹剑宗还有没有其他顶级主神。关于他们的真正实力，我了解不算很多，檀落云并没有跟我透露过任何消息。”风长卿说道。
“呵呵，檀奕在飘渺神宫，赵荀川又被杀，檀落云不是去找过你，胁迫你们飘渺神宫归附于青虹剑宗吗，难道檀落云没有跟你交底过？”
风长卿脸上露出一抹苦涩的笑，莫凡连这件事都知道了。
檀奕和赵荀川出事后，檀落云确实去飘渺神宫找了他，并且胁迫他，想把飘渺神宫吞掉。
他个人的实力不如檀落云，飘渺神宫的实力也不如青虹剑宗，无奈之下，他只能答应了檀落云，带着飘渺神宫归附于青虹剑宗。
只不过这件事秘而不宣，除了飘渺神宫和青虹剑宗的核心长老外，其他人并不知晓。
关于这件事，神域也有一些传闻，但那些传闻都无根无据，没人敢相信，只是作为谈资而已。
“主人，檀奕失踪、赵荀川被杀之后，檀落云是到飘渺神宫找过我。我的实力不如他，不得不带着飘渺神宫归附青虹剑宗。这个关系没有让外人知道，只有两宗之间的核心长老才知道。”风长卿如实相告。
顿了一顿，他继续说道：“檀落云是一个很小心谨慎，也很有心机的人，他从来没有跟我说过青虹剑宗究竟有几个顶级主神。不过我猜测，青虹剑宗应该是跟大慈恩禅寺一样，隐藏了实力，很可能还有一个顶级主神。”
“你确定？”莫凡问。
“我不敢确定，但至少有八成可能。我只知道，青虹剑宗有两个实力很强的核心长老闭死关，已经有上万年没有现身。所以我觉得，这两个长老很有可能已经有一个突破到顶级主神。最坏的情况，就是他们两人都是顶级主神了。”
莫凡微笑点点头，“有意思。这种情况，果然跟黑莲寺、大慈恩禅寺很相似，都是有长老闭死关，闭着闭着就成为顶级主神了。你们飘渺神宫呢，有没有长老闭死关试图突破顶级主神？”
“飘渺神宫的实力比青虹剑宗弱不少，但也有一个核心长老在闭死关，已经闭关八千多年。不过，他还没有成功突破，现在还是普通主神。”
“行了，既然你被檀落云胁迫过，让你们飘渺神宫成为青虹剑宗的附庸，我很快就会给你一个报仇的机会。你在这里等着我。”
说罢，莫凡和叶泠音的身影瞬间消失。
报仇的机会？
风长卿马上猜到莫凡说的是什么。
莫凡很快就要出手屠灭青虹剑宗出手了。
而他，就是莫凡手里的一把刀，或者说是一条狗。
他要帮莫凡杀人，帮莫凡咬人。
现在莫凡去而复返，这么急着在他元神上种下能掌控他生死的秘术或咒术，就是要他出力，帮莫凡屠灭青虹剑宗。
莫凡带着叶泠音出现在始元戒世界的另外一个山谷上空。
山谷里，一个绝色女子抬起头来，看到莫凡之后，脸色瞬间变白。
叶泠音微微一愣，也马上知道莫凡为什么要把她带进始元戒世界，只留下云浅月一个人继续监视青虹剑宗。
山谷里的那个绝色女子，是瑶光神宗宗主梦雨蝶，也是叶泠音熟识的人。
莫凡既然把风长卿收作随从，那么现在应该是想把梦雨蝶也收作随从。
莫凡带她来到这里，是让她见证，或者劝说梦雨蝶，让梦雨蝶成为莫凡的随从。
content_en:
"Returning to the master, I don't know if there are other top master gods in the Qinghong Sword Sect. I don't know much about their true strength. Tan Luoyun has not disclosed any information to me." Feng Changqing said.
"Haha, Tan Yi was in the Piaomiao Shrine, and Zhao Xunchuan was killed again. Didn't Tan Luoyun go to find you and force your Piaomiao Shrine to join the Qinghong Sword Sect? Didn't Tan Luoyun tell you the truth?"
Feng Changqing had a bitter smile on his face, Mo Fan even knew about this.
After Tan Yi and Zhao Xunchuan's incident, Tan Luoyun did go to Piaomiao Shrine to find him, and coerced him, hoping to devour Piaomiao Shrine.
His personal strength is not as good as Tan Luoyun, and the strength of Piaomiao Shrine is not as good as that of Qinghong Sword Sect. In desperation, he can only agree to Tan Luoyun and bring Piaomiao Shrine to join Qinghong Sword Sect.
It's just that this matter is kept secret. Except for the core elders of Piaomiao Shrine and Qinghong Sword Sect, no one else knows about it.
Regarding this matter, there are also some rumors in the Divine Realm, but those rumors are baseless and no one dares to believe them. They are just used as talking points.
"Master, after Tan Yi disappeared and Zhao Xunchuan was killed, Tan Luoyun came to Piaomiao Shrine to look for me. I was not as strong as him, so I had to bring Piaomiao Shrine to join the Qinghong Sword Sect. This relationship was not known to outsiders. Only the core elders between the two sects knew about it." Feng Changqing told the truth.
After a pause, he continued: "Tan Luoyun is a very cautious and scheming person. He has never told me how many top chief gods the Qinghong Sword Sect has. However, I guess that the Qinghong Sword Sect is like the Daci'en Temple in that it hides its strength, and it is possible that there is another top chief god."
"Are you sure?" Mo Fan asked.
"I'm not sure, but it's at least 80% possible. All I know is that the Qinghong Sword Sect has two very powerful core elders who are in retreat and haven't shown up for tens of thousands of years. So I think it's very likely that one of these two elders has already broken through to the top level of the main god. The worst case scenario is that both of them are top level main gods."
Mo Fan smiled and nodded, "Interesting. This situation is indeed very similar to that of Black Lotus Temple and Daci'en Temple. They both have elders who retreat to death, and they become the top main gods by staying in retreat. In your Misty Shrine, do you have any elders who retreat to try to break through to the top main god?"
"The strength of the Piaomiao Shrine is much weaker than that of the Qinghong Sword Sect, but there is also a core elder who has been in seclusion for more than 8,000 years. However, he has not yet succeeded in breaking through, and he is still an ordinary main god."
"Okay, since you were coerced by Tan Luoyun and made your Misty Palace become a vassal of the Qinghong Sword Sect, I will give you a chance for revenge soon. You wait for me here."
After saying that, Mo Fan and Ye Lingyin disappeared instantly.
A chance for revenge?
Feng Changqing immediately guessed what Mo Fan was talking about.
Mo Fan will soon take action to kill the Qinghong Sword Sect.
And he is a knife in Mo Fan's hand, or a dog.
He wants to help Mo Fan kill people and help Mo Fan bite people.
Now that Mo Fan has left and returned, he is so eager to plant a secret technique or spell on his soul that can control his life and death, just to ask him to help Mo Fan kill the Qinghong Sword Sect.
Mo Fan and Ye Lingyin appeared above another valley in the world of Shiyuan Ring.
In the valley, a stunningly beautiful woman raised her head, and her face instantly turned pale when she saw Mo Fan.
Ye Lingyin was slightly stunned, and immediately knew why Mo Fan brought her into the world of the First Yuan Ring, leaving Yun Qianyue alone to continue to monitor the Qinghong Sword Sect.
The stunning woman in the valley was Meng Yudie, the leader of the Yaoguang Shen Sect, and someone Ye Lingyin knew well.
Since Mo Fan has taken Feng Changqing as his follower, he should now want to take Meng Yudie as his follower.
Mo Fan brought her here to let her witness, or to persuade Meng Yudie to become Mo Fan's follower.
